title: EasyFAB Macro Projects
description: Projects have one or more equally responsible Engineers in engineer_ids. Legacy stored lead_engineer_id is read as a single-member assignment; dual assignment fields are rejected. New assignments require active trusted Engineers without duplicates. Existing unknown fields are preserved. A positive contribution from any assigned Engineer starts the project; queries have no write effects and preserve On Hold/Completed. No location migration is implied. For explicitly activated result-oriented projects, projects.json retains identity/name/WBS/area; current dates, engineer_ids and status in overview are projected from signed project results. Historical index values are not dual-written. Engineer filtering uses the current projected assignments.

lead_engineer_id.description: Legacy persisted assignment, read as a one-person engineer_ids list. Never emitted by the current API.
